geometry_source: EU5 calibrated location geometry plus the Rawk Nasiri cultivated-land total summarized by the UN Population Bulletin and the EGYLandscape cadastral GIS description.

crosswalks.historical_boundary: Rawk Nasiri 1298/1315 cultivated/fiscal land units in Egypt; the published total is 3,637,000 feddans (approximately 15,278 km2 using 4,200.833 m2 per feddan). This is not a closed polygon and is not equivalent to every desert, oasis, port and city footprint in the broad EU5 Egypt selector.
crosswalks.boundary_confidence: high for 60 EU5 selector members; low for equivalence to the 1315 cultivated/fiscal boundary

area_comparison.interpretation: The 13.97% ratio is a cultivated-land-to-broad-envelope diagnostic, not a claim that only 13.97% of the historical population belonged to Egypt. The Rawk total measures surveyed cultivated land while the EU5 selector measures modern map-location footprints containing extensive desert and urban areas. No area-weighted population allocation is permitted from this ratio.

selector_content_diagnostic.caveat: This 16-location exclusion is a reproducible map diagnostic, not a historical Rawk boundary reconstruction. It must not be used as a replacement training selector. It demonstrates why the existing 1.0 crosswalk coverage is only selector completeness, not source-boundary coverage.

crosswalks.resolution_method: Enumerate all 60 locations selected by the existing lower_egypt_area|upper_egypt_area selector from location_geometry_calibrated.parquet; compare the summed calibrated footprint with the published 3,637,000-feddan cultivated-land total; retain a separate diagnostic list of obvious oasis, desert, Red Sea port and Sinai-adjacent locations. Do not infer population or capacity from the area ratio and do not promote the floor.
required_actions: digitize the Rawk Nasiri village/province cadastral units and intersect them with EU5 geometry
separate cultivated rural land from Cairo, Alexandria, Fayyum city and other urban redistribution hubs
verify whether oases and Red Sea ports are in the population source's boundary rather than assuming broad Egypt membership
find an independent population/capacity interval and documented local-food share
require >=95% historical-boundary equivalence before any future target use
crosswalks.notes: The old 3.4 million floor is not applied to the 60-location selector after this downgrade. The selector is retained only for physical diagnostics and validation; broad membership coverage must not be reported as a closed Rawk rural crosswalk.
